title: pleurophora polyandra var. squarrosa
intro: Pleurophora polyandra var. squarrosa, commonly known as "Wild Verbena", is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Pleurophora polyandra var. squarrosa include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating skin and respiratory issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
